producer: Revision/lead_checks/einstein_gauss_bonnet_a4.py (lead, independent; no Revision code imported; reads the record Revision/field_equations_a4/a4-equations.json to compare)

checks.name: einstein_diagonal_x0_independent
checks.detail: every diagonal component of G^mu_nu is independent of x0 (z) and of e^(a4), and depends on b4 only through u = b4'/b4 and v = u'

checks.name: einstein_off_diagonal
checks.detail: the only nonzero off-diagonal components are G^x4_x0 = (3/2) H cot z b4'/b4 and G^x0_x4 = -(3/2) H tan z b4'/b4

checks.name: einstein_isotropy
checks.detail: G^x1_x1 = G^x2_x2 = G^x3_x3 and G^x5_x5 = G^x6_x6 = G^x7_x7

checks.name: einstein_constraint_x4
checks.detail: G^x4_x4 + Lambda = kappa T: mine = 21*H**2 + Lam + 3*a1**2 - 3*a1*u/2 + kappa*rho - 3*u**2/4; record: 3*ad1^2 + 21*H^2 + Lam - (3*ad1*uu)/2 - (3*uu^2)/4 == -(kappa*rho)

checks.name: einstein_space_x1
checks.detail: G^x1_x1 + Lambda = kappa T: mine = 15*H**2 + Lam - 3*a1**2 + 3*a1*u + a2 - kappa*p3 - 3*u**2/2 - 3*v/2; record: -3*ad1^2 + ad2 + 15*H^2 + Lam + 3*ad1*uu - (3*uu^2)/2 - (3*vv)/2 == kappa*p3

checks.name: einstein_extraTime_x5
checks.detail: G^x5_x5 + Lambda = kappa T: mine = 15*H**2 + Lam - 3*a1**2 - a2 - kappa*pt - 3*u**2/4 - v; record: -3*ad1^2 - ad2 + 15*H^2 + Lam - (3*uu^2)/4 - vv == kappa*pt

checks.name: einstein_hidden_x0
checks.detail: G^x0_x0 + Lambda = kappa T: mine = 15*H**2 + Lam - 3*a1**2 + 3*a1*u/2 - kappa*p0 - 3*u**2/2 - 3*v/2; record: -3*ad1^2 + 15*H^2 + Lam + (3*ad1*uu)/2 - (3*uu^2)/2 - (3*vv)/2 == kappa*p0

checks.name: einstein_offDiagonal_x4x0
checks.detail: G^x4_x0 = kappa q40: mine 3*H*c*u/(2*t**6) - kappa*q40 = 0; record (3*cc*H*uu)/2 == kappa*q40

checks.name: no_vacuum_for_H_positive
checks.detail: T = 0: the x4-x0 component (3/2) H cot z b4'/b4 = 0 forces b4'/b4 = 0, and then G^x4_x4 - G^x0_x0 = 6 a4'^2 + 6 H^2 > 0 for H > 0: no vacuum solution for any Lambda, a4 and b4

checks.name: gauss_bonnet_source_alpha2
checks.detail: alpha_2 parts of kappa rho, kappa p3, kappa p_t, kappa p0 in the record equal -H^x4_x4, H^x1_x1, H^x5_x5, H^x0_x0 of the classical Gauss-Bonnet tensor (record rho: 3*H**4*(3*A**4*beta**3 - 24*A**4*beta + 24*A**4 - 20*A**2*beta**2 - 40*A**2*beta + 80*A**2 + 280)/2)

checks.name: gauss_bonnet_offdiagonal_alpha2
checks.detail: alpha_2 part of kappa q40 in the record equals H^x4_x0 of the classical Gauss-Bonnet tensor: 3*A*H**4*beta*c*(A**2*beta**2 + 12*A**2*beta - 24*A**2 - 40)/(2*t**6)

checks.name: einstein_exponential_source_alpha1
checks.detail: alpha_1 parts of kappa rho, p3, p_t, p0 and q40 in the record equal -G^x4_x4, G^x1_x1, G^x5_x5, G^x0_x0 and G^x4_x0 on the history: [3*H**2*(A**2*beta**2 + 2*A**2*beta - 4*A**2 - 28)/4, -3*H**2*(A**2*beta**2 - 2*A**2*beta + 2*A**2 - 10)/2, -3*H**2*(A**2*beta**2 + 4*A**2 - 20)/4, -3*H**2*(A**2*beta**2 - A**2*beta + 2*A**2 - 10)/2]
